<plan>
drive car2 dhunche-hospital kalika-temple
load car2 elderly 2
drive car2 kalika-temple dhunche-hospital
unload car2 elderly 2
drive car2 dhunche-hospital likhu-village
load car2 injured 4
drive car2 likhu-village dhunche-hospital
unload car2 injured 4
drive car2 dhunche-hospital likhu-village
load car2 adult 4
drive car2 likhu-village dhunche-hospital
unload car2 adult 4
drive car1 benighat-shelter nilkantha-farm
load car1 injured 2
load car1 adult 1
drive car1 nilkantha-farm benighat-shelter

</plan>
COST: 192

Everyone is rescued, so no one is deferred. Car2 makes two round trips to Likhu village (22 minutes each way) and one to Kalika temple (30 minutes each way), and car1 makes one round trip to Nilkantha farm (22 minutes each way). Kalika temple is never used as a drop-off point.
